tips.text: Ask a clanmate for the refined gems; they trade, so neither Rank 4 is needed.
Stay in after the first Rotation C reward; every round from 4 on can pay C again.
Kill Demolysts instead of letting one destroy a conduit; three or four defended conduits pay the same C table.
Run Kappa in a premade squad that kills Demolysts fast; public squads often leave before Rotation C.
Skip the Duviri Circuit for Gauss; he is not in its rotation, so Kappa is the only part source.
Expect duplicates: each part rolls on its own, so one can stay missing long after the others.
Players report anywhere from half an hour to seven hours for the three parts.
Almost nobody regrets building Gauss, even players who call Kappa the worst farm they did.
